Black_Rot.quote: V-shaped areas with the wide part of the 'V' at the edge of the leaf and the point of the 'V' toward the attachment point of the leaf to the plant.
interior stem tissue (specifically the water conducting tissue) will also turn brown or black, and infected plants subsequently tend to show symptoms of wilting.
Symptoms on cauliflower may appear as numerous black or brown specks, black veins, and discolored curds.

Downy_Mildew.quote: Small, angular, light green to yellow lesions on the upper leaf surface.
Pale brown to gray discoloration will appear on the surface of the curd or head, and grayish or black spots will develop on the stem beneath.
dark, discolored zones spread from the crown into the taproot.
